result.summary: This PR strengthens the unit tests for the legacy ParseHDKeypath function (used only when loading legacy wallets) by checking the actual parsed keypath values instead of just the boolean result, adding round-trip encode/decode tests, and adding negative tests for unsupported delimiters. It also renames ParseHDKeypath to ParseHDKeypathLegacy to reduce confusion with the similar ParseKeyPath in descriptor.cpp. No production behavior changes except the mechanical rename across call sites.
result.problem: The existing unit test for ParseHDKeypath only checked the boolean success/failure result, not the actual parsed output, so a broken implementation (e.g. clearing the keypath before returning true) would silently pass. This is a test-quality gap that anyone modifying the legacy keypath parser would hit.

result.card: This PR improves unit test coverage for the legacy ParseHDKeypath function used only when loading legacy wallets, adding checks on the actual parsed output, round-trip tests, and negative tests, plus renaming it to ParseHDKeypathLegacy to avoid confusion with the similar descriptor.cpp parser. The author demonstrated the prior test gap by showing a broken implementation (clearing the keypath before returning true) would still pass all existing tests, which is the strongest evidence of value. Three reviewers gave concept ACKs and one gave a code review ACK with only nits, all addressed; no production behavior changes except the mechanical rename. The PR has survived two rebases through conflicting merges (#32784, #35069) and the author declared it ready for review as of 2026-08-21. Impact is narrow since it touches only a legacy, soon-to-be-superseded code path.
